metadata.scenario: A homeowner calls to report that the repair work done last week did not resolve the issue as promised. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Karen Lewis, and I was referred by my husband's cardiac surgeon's office. Nice to meet you, Karen. How can I help you regarding your husband’s care? Well, my husband needs post-operative care after his upcoming cardiac surgery next month. Absolutely, we can provide that. What specific services are you looking for? I want to know about post-surgery recovery care and maybe some skilled nursing as well. Sure! Our Post-Surgery Recovery Care is priced at $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours. Skilled nursing is $95 to $125 for 1 to 2 hours. Okay, that sounds reasonable. But I also have a concern regarding a service complaint. I’m sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about the issue? Last week, my husband had a home health aide come in for a few hours, but it didn’t help as promised. I apologize for that, Karen. What specific issues did you experience with the aide? The aide didn’t assist my husband properly with his mobility exercises, and his pain management wasn’t addressed. That’s very concerning. I understand how important this is for his recovery. Yes, it is. I’m worried about his condition worsening without proper care. I completely understand. I’d like to gather more details so we can address this immediately. Thank you, I appreciate that. What do you need from me? Can you provide the name of the aide who visited and the specific dates? Sure, her name was Sarah Williams, and she was here last Tuesday. Thank you, Karen. I’ll follow up with Sarah and review the care provided. I hope that helps. His surgery is next month, and we need to ensure he’s ready. Of course. I can also set up a skilled nursing plan for post-surgery to ensure he gets the care he needs. That would be great. Can we schedule that now? Yes, let’s plan to schedule skilled nursing care starting the day after his surgery. Perfect, I’ll keep that in mind. What’s the pricing again? It’s $95 to $125 for a visit of 1 to 2 hours. Sounds good. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome! I’ll follow up regarding the complaint and your husband’s care plan. I appreciate it. Have a great day! You too, Karen. Take care!
